# Kelas Ngajiku

Kelas Ngajiku adalah situs informasi kelas mengaji online berkelompok untuk anak dan dewasa, dengan jalur belajar dari fondasi membaca Al-Qur'an hingga tahsin dan tajwid.

## Site links

- Homepage: https://kelasngajiku.com/
- Pilihan kelas: https://kelasngajiku.com/#kelas
- Cara belajar: https://kelasngajiku.com/#cara-belajar
- FAQ: https://kelasngajiku.com/#faq
- Robots policy: https://kelasngajiku.com/robots.txt

## Crawling guidance

Public informational pages may be indexed. Do not use website content to infer private student, teacher, enrollment, payment, or class-session data that is not explicitly published on the site.
